ns2:course.label: Structure and Function III
ns2:course.description: Teaches comparative gross equine, bovine, ovine, caprine, and porcine anatomy; histology of the respiratory, urinary and special senses systems; respiratory and renal physiology; basic animal nutrition; and clinical correlations between these subjects and the clinical experiences of VM 601. Prerequisite: VM 603 and good-standing in the veterinary professional curriculum, or consent of instructor.
